summary: Shows penalty/Lagrangian methods for chance-constrained RL oscillate or become over-conservative and proposes a separated PI-Lagrangian with integral limiting.
relation: Directly documents Lagrangian over-conservatism under chance constraints, matching the 10% success failure mode.

title: Multi-Agent Constrained Policy Optimisation
summary: Preprint introducing MACPO and MAPPO-L with monotonic reward improvement and constraint satisfaction guarantees for cooperative safe MARL.
relation: Original preprint of the MAPPO-Lagrangian baseline.

title: Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Shielding
summary: Centralized and factored shields that monitor and correct MARL agents' joint actions to guarantee safety during learning; factored shields scale better with agent count.
relation: Direct precedent for a per-agent/factored safety layer in MARL; assumes a known safety model, whereas the thesis' shield uses a learned, belief-dependent dose prediction.

title: Reinforcement Learning with Almost Sure Constraints
summary: Shows stationary policies are insufficient for probability-one constraints and endows the controller with a budget state; the minimal safe budget is a fixed point of a Bellman-like operator, learnable from samples.
relation: Theoretical underpinning of 'dose so far + required exit dose <= budget' as a minimal-budget/viability condition.

title: A predictive safety filter for learning-based control of constrained nonlinear dynamical systems
summary: MPC-based predictive safety filter that certifies a learning controller's input by checking a feasible backup trajectory to a safe set.
relation: The exit-reserve check is a predictive safety filter whose backup plan is 'withdraw to exit'.

title: Recovery RL: Safe Reinforcement Learning With Learned Recovery Zones
summary: Separates a task policy from a recovery policy triggered by a learned safety critic when violation is likely.
relation: Analogue of the thesis' withdraw action as a recovery behaviour triggered by a learned risk estimate.

title: Responsive Safety in Reinforcement Learning by PID Lagrangian Methods
summary: Shows Lagrangian multiplier dynamics oscillate and overshoot, and adds proportional and derivative terms to the dual update to reduce violations and oscillation.
relation: Key reference for diagnosing why MAPPO-Lagrangian became timid/unstable and for a PID-Lagrangian ablation.

title: Safe Reinforcement Learning in Constrained Markov Decision Processes
summary: SNO-MDP explores and optimizes CMDPs with unknown safety constraints, first expanding the certified-safe region then optimizing reward.
relation: Supports the thesis' treatment of the dose field as an unknown constraint learned from observations.

title: Safe Reinforcement Learning via Shielding
summary: Introduces shields synthesized from temporal-logic specifications that block or correct unsafe actions of an RL agent (preemptive and post-posed shielding).
relation: Seminal shielding paper; the thesis' dose mask is a preemptive shield with a probabilistic (quantile) rather than formal model.

title: Safe Exploration in Continuous Action Spaces
summary: Adds a safety layer that analytically corrects actions using a learned linear model of single-step constraint cost, achieving near-zero violations during training.
relation: Seminal 'safety layer' with a learned one-step cost model, the closest single-agent analogue to predicting next-step dose and filtering actions.

title: Safe Exploration and Optimization of Constrained MDPs Using Gaussian Processes
summary: Models unknown state safety with a GP and balances exploring safety, exploring reward and exploitation, demonstrated on Martian terrain.
relation: Close analogue: a field robot with an a-priori unknown, spatially varying hazard learned online.

title: A General Safety Framework for Learning-Based Control in Uncertain Robotic Systems
summary: HJ-reachability safety controller that minimally overrides an arbitrary learner, with Bayesian refinement of the safety analysis as evidence accrues.
relation: Least-restrictive supervisory filter whose conservativeness adapts to posterior uncertainty, conceptually like the thesis' posterior-quantile mask plus withdraw override.

title: Safe Exploration in Finite Markov Decision Processes with Gaussian Processes
summary: Explores an MDP with an unknown GP-modelled safety function, only visiting states that are safe with high probability and from which a safe return is possible.
relation: Precedent for the exit-reserve (returnability) condition under an unknown cost map.

title: Risk-Constrained Reinforcement Learning with Percentile Risk Criteria
summary: Policy-gradient and actor-critic algorithms for CMDPs with chance (VaR) and CVaR constraints on cumulative cost.
relation: Formal precedent for constraining the probability/tail of cumulative cost, akin to the thesis' 5% violation target.

title: Iterative Risk Allocation: A new approach to robust Model Predictive Control with a joint chance constraint
summary: Iteratively allocates a joint chance-constraint risk budget among individual constraints/time steps in robust MPC, reducing conservatism of uniform allocation.
relation: Conceptual basis for splitting the 5% mission-level violation budget across robots and steps (choice of the quantile level).

title: Safe on Average, Unsafe in the Tail: When Is the Episodic-Cost Tail Controllable?
summary: Shows policies satisfying expected-cost budgets can violate them in the worst 10% of episodes (CVaR0.1) and studies constraint families for tail control.
relation: Supports evaluating dose overruns in the tail rather than on average, aligned with the thesis' percentile-based safety.

title: RBGA: Residual-Budget Guide Arbitration for Offline-to-Online Safe Reinforcement Learning in Dexterous Manipulation
summary: RBGA tracks the remaining within-episode safety budget and compares cost-to-go of candidate actions against it to arbitrate actions.
relation: Precedent for conditioning decisions on remaining budget and predicted cost-to-go, like dose-left-vs-exit-cost checks.

title: SafeDiSTL: Decomposing Joint Constraints for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: SafeDiSTL allocates team-level constraint violation increments across agents via action sensitivities for constrained MARL.
relation: Relevant to attributing shared safety cost among agents, related to risk sharing.

title: Restorative Control and the Limits of Safe Model Discrimination
summary: Reach-avoid restorative control where systems accumulate irreversible damage from exposure; bounds required exposure against tolerances under model uncertainty.
relation: Conceptual parallel: cumulative irreversible exposure versus tolerance under model ambiguity.

title: Hull-Fence: Online Multi-Robot Safe Coverage in Unknown Environments with Convex-Hull Hazard Cordoning
summary: Hull-Fence: hierarchical CTDE MARL for multi-robot coverage of unknown maps while avoiding latent hazardous regions, with a CVaR-trained distributional critic; reduces per-agent hazard exposure to 7.8%.
relation: Multi-robot learned policy with tail-risk hazard exposure, close in spirit; hazards are regions to avoid rather than a cumulative dose budget tied to an uncertain source estimate.

title: DynBudget: Adaptive Risk Calibration and Dynamic Budgeting for Safe Reinforcement Learning Under Distribution Drift
summary: DynBudget combines a learned safety critic, temperature-calibrated risk estimates and a dynamic safety budget to adapt shielding under environment drift (MiniGrid, Safety-Gymnasium).
relation: Relevant to the thesis's finding on miscalibrated (overconfident) risk estimates feeding a safety mask; offers calibration as a remedy.

title: Sampling-Based Safe Reinforcement Learning
summary: SBSRL enforces safety constraints jointly across a finite set of sampled dynamics models, approximating worst-case safety under epistemic uncertainty with guarantees.
relation: Constraint over samples mirrors the thesis's masking over particle-filter samples; single-agent, no budget.

title: RAYA: Learning Where and When to Intervene for Robot Recovery
summary: RAYA embeds a learned recoverability margin in an optimal controller and shifts task weights as recoverability shrinks, improving survival.
relation: Conceptual analog of keeping an exit reserve: preserve what recovery needs while acting; not radiation or multi-agent.

title: LyMARL: A Lyapunov-Guided Multiagent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Energy-Aware Radio Resource Management
summary: LyMARL embeds Lyapunov virtual-queue budget dynamics into state and reward of a CTDE MARL framework to respect finite-horizon energy budgets.
relation: Budget state augmentation in MARL analog to remaining-dose observations; wireless domain.

title: Characterization and Analysis of Emergency Landing Flight Envelopes with Graded Safety Specifications
summary: HJ reachability framework where limited cumulative time in degraded states is tolerated via soft trajectory-dependent constraints for emergency landing envelopes.
relation: Cumulative exposure-style safety constraint analog to a dose budget.

title: Risk-Aware Switch-Time Recovery Planning (ReSwitch) for High-Speed Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) Pursuit–Evasion
summary: ReSwitch separates pursuit from safety recovery and selects the switching time to begin recovery via hybrid rollouts once finite-horizon risk emerges in UAV pursuit-evasion.
relation: Analogous to deciding when to withdraw; not dose or multi-robot search.

title: On the Equilibrium Between Feasible Zone and Uncertain Model in Safe Exploration
venue: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
summary: Safe equilibrium exploration (SEE) alternates between maximum feasible zone and least uncertain model, proving monotone expansion and convergence with zero violations.
relation: Formalizes the interdependence between model uncertainty and safe set, as in the thesis where the safety mask depends on the uncertain source estimate.

title: Dyna-Style Safety Augmented Reinforcement Learning: Staying Safe in the Face of Uncertainty
summary: Dyna-SAuR learns a policy and a safety filter from an uncertainty-aware dynamics model, avoiding failures and regions of high model uncertainty; reduces failures by two orders of magnitude.
relation: Uncertainty-aware safety filtering, analogous to percentile-over-particles masking.

title: Neuro-Symbolic Risk Semantics for Safe Multi-Agent Coverage in Hazardous Environments
venue: IEEE International Joint Conference on Neural Network
summary: FMEA-Net provides differentiable failure-mode risk semantics conditioning decentralized actors for safe multi-agent coverage, robust to risk-model mismatch.
relation: Multi-agent hazardous coverage with structured risk; no cumulative budget.

title: Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Radio Resource Management under Coupled Finite-Horizon Constraints
summary: HeLyMARL uses drift-plus-penalty virtual queues to enforce hard finite-horizon energy/handover budgets within episodes, outperforming Lagrangian MARL which only regulates across episodes.
relation: Shows Lagrangian methods do not pace within-episode budgets; relevant critique for MAPPO-Lagrangian with hard dose budgets.

title: Open and Auditable Drawdown Control: An Exit-Reserve Shield for Learned Portfolios
venue: Proceedings of the International Conference on Open Finance (ICOF 2026)
summary: Defines an exit-reserve set of states from which a safe liquidation remains possible and projects learned portfolio actions onto actions preserving it, with conditional guarantees.
relation: Conceptual analogue of the thesis' exit reserve (always keep enough to exit), from finance.

title: ProSh: Probabilistic Shielding for Model-free Reinforcement Learning
summary: ProSh augments the CMDP state with a risk budget and shields the policy distribution using a learned cost critic, bounding expected cost during training.
relation: Budget-in-state plus shield is structurally similar to the thesis (remaining dose in observation + mask), but cost is learned, not predicted from a source estimate, and single-agent.

title: Distributed primal-dual algorithm for constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning under coupled policies
summary: Distributed primal-dual algorithm for constrained MARL with coupled policies where each agent has its own safety constraint and local Lagrange multipliers.
relation: Per-agent constraints with local multipliers parallel per-robot dose budgets in MAPPO-Lagrangian.

title: Resolving Conflicting Constraints in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Layered Safety
summary: Combines MARL that learns to avoid multi-agent conflicts with control-barrier/reachability safety filters for multi-robot navigation.
relation: Precedent for MARL plus a safety layer; collision constraints rather than dose.

title: The Lagrangian Method for Solving Constrained Markov Games
summary: Lagrangian-game primal-dual method for constrained Markov games where agents face cost constraints, e.g. teams under local energy and time constraints.
relation: Theoretical grounding for Lagrangian MARL with per-agent costs.

title: Rectified Robust Policy Optimization for Model-Uncertain Constrained Reinforcement Learning without Strong Duality
summary: Shows strong duality fails in robust constrained RL and proposes primal-only RRPO with convergence guarantees under model uncertainty.
relation: Relevant to Lagrangian methods under model error, which the thesis encounters.

title: Solving Multi-Agent Safe Optimal Control with Distributed Epigraph Form MARL
summary: Def-MARL uses the epigraph form to solve multi-agent safe optimal control with zero constraint violation in a distributed CTDE manner; tested in simulation and on Crazyflies.
relation: Alternative to MAPPO-Lagrangian for hard per-agent constraints.

title: Scalable Constrained Policy Optimization for Safe Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Proposes a scalable constrained policy optimization method for safe MARL, motivated by controlling many agents (e.g., drone swarms, autonomous driving) safely and cooperatively (summary from title and truncated abstract only).
relation: State-of-the-art safe-MARL baseline family (expected-cost constraints) relevant to scaling the thesis beyond a few robots.

title: A Survey of Constraint Formulations in Safe Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reviews and relates constraint formulations (expected cumulative, chance, almost-sure, state-wise, CVaR) and matching algorithms.
relation: Helps position the mission-level chance constraint relative to expected-cost CMDPs.

title: ActSafe: Active Exploration with Safety Constraints for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Model-based RL that is optimistic on epistemic uncertainty for exploration but pessimistic for safety constraints, with safety guarantees during learning.
relation: Analogous to masking actions using pessimistic (upper-percentile) dose predictions under estimate uncertainty.

title: CVaR-Constrained Policy Optimization for Safe Reinforcement Learning
venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems
summary: CVaR-CPO constrains the CVaR of cumulative cost via state augmentation, trust region and Lagrangian updates, with quantile-based CVaR value estimation.
relation: Tail-risk constraint on cumulative cost with state augmentation, relevant to replacing expectation-level dose constraints; single-agent.

title: Safe Multiagent Coordination via Entropic Exploration
summary: E2C analyzes joint team constraints versus individual constraints in constrained MARL and uses observation-entropy maximization to aid safe cooperative exploration.
relation: Team vs individual constraint comparison bears on pooled vs per-robot dose budgets and risk sharing.

title: The Price of Failure Risk: Clipped Barrier Policy Gradients with Convex Regularization
summary: Augments the state with the remaining resource budget and uses clipped barrier rewards so policy gradients control the probability of exhausting it within a horizon; proves convergence.
relation: Formal treatment of a non-renewable budget in the state with exhaustion risk, close to the thesis' dose budget formulation.

title: Provably Efficient Generalized Lagrangian Policy Optimization for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Generalized Lagrangian with upper-confidence exploration for episodic two-player zero-sum constrained Markov games with unknown transitions, achieving sublinear regret and constraint violation.
relation: Theoretical safe-MARL Lagrangian reference; shows constraint violation is only controlled on average/sublinearly, unlike the thesis' hard per-step mask.

title: Scalable Primal-Dual Actor-Critic Method for Safe Multi-Agent RL with General Utilities
summary: Scalable primal-dual actor-critic for safe MARL where each agent has its own safety constraint, using shadow rewards and kappa-hop truncation, with convergence guarantees.
relation: Per-agent constraints in MARL theory, relevant to individual dose budgets; no hazard-search application.

title: Safe Exploration in Reinforcement Learning: A Generalized Formulation and Algorithms
summary: MASE combines unconstrained RL with an uncertainty quantifier to guarantee safety within an episode and penalize unsafe exploration before violation.
relation: Uncertainty-quantified safety guarantee with early intervention, relevant to the thesis's percentile-based mask and withdraw action.

title: A Closer Look at Invalid Action Masking in Policy Gradient Algorithms
summary: Shows invalid-action masking yields a valid policy gradient and greatly improves PPO performance in large discrete action spaces.
relation: Justifies the gradient correctness of applying a state-dependent mask inside MAPPO.

title: The Surprising Effectiveness of PPO in Cooperative Multi-Agent Games
summary: Shows MAPPO with centralized value function is a strong cooperative MARL baseline across benchmarks.
relation: Base algorithm of the thesis (MAPPO).

title: Decentralized Policy Gradient Descent Ascent for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Safe Dec-PG: decentralized primal-dual policy gradient for networked agents each with individual rewards and coupled safety constraints, with convergence rates.
relation: Per-agent constraint formulation in MARL solved with primal-dual updates; background for MAPPO-L style approaches.

title: WCSAC: Worst-Case Soft Actor Critic for Safety-Constrained Reinforcement Learning
summary: WCSAC adds a safety critic and constrains a CVaR of the cost distribution rather than its expectation.
relation: Tail-risk constraint precedent for the thesis' 97th-percentile dose masking.

title: Learning to be Safe: Deep RL with a Safety Critic
summary: Learns a safety critic in prior tasks and uses it to constrain/filter actions when learning new tasks, reducing safety incidents.
relation: Learned-cost action filtering, related to using a learned dose predictor in the mask.

title: Maximizing Information Gain in Partially Observable Environments via Prediction Rewards
summary: Shows prediction rewards relate to negative entropy and enable belief-based information-gain rewards in deep RL for active perception.
relation: Grounds belief/entropy-based rewards for the source-localization objective.

title: End-to-End Safe Reinforcement Learning through Barrier Functions for Safety-Critical Continuous Control Tasks
summary: Combines model-free RL with a CBF-based controller and GP model of uncertain dynamics to guarantee safety during learning.
relation: CBF-based safety layer with learned uncertainty, the continuous-control counterpart of the thesis' mask.

title: Reward Constrained Policy Optimization
summary: RCPO uses a multi-timescale Lagrangian penalty signal to steer policies toward constraint-satisfying solutions.
relation: Canonical Lagrangian safe-RL baseline underlying MAPPO-L.

title: A Lyapunov-based Approach to Safe Reinforcement Learning
summary: Constructs Lyapunov functions that turn the CMDP cumulative constraint into local linear per-step constraints guaranteeing safety during training.
relation: Related idea of converting a cumulative budget into per-step feasibility conditions, as in the thesis' step-wise dose check.

title: Constrained Policy Optimization
summary: Trust-region policy search with near-constraint satisfaction at each iteration for CMDPs.
relation: Seminal constrained policy-gradient method that MACPO extends to multi-agent settings.

title: Risk-Sensitive and Robust Decision-Making: a CVaR Optimization Approach
summary: Shows CVaR objectives equal expected cost under worst-case model errors for a given error budget and gives approximate value iteration for CVaR MDPs.
relation: Justifies pessimistic quantile/CVaR treatment of an uncertain dose model.

title: Safe Exploration for Optimization with Gaussian Processes
summary: SafeOpt: GP-based Bayesian optimization that only evaluates points whose safety (unknown function) is above a threshold with high probability.
relation: Seminal method for acting safely under an unknown, learned constraint using confidence bounds, akin to a pessimistic posterior quantile.

title: Safe Exploration in Markov Decision Processes
summary: Defines safety as the ability to return (ergodicity) and gives an efficient algorithm restricting exploration to guaranteed-safe policies; NP-hard in general.
relation: Formal precedent for the exit-reserve idea (always being able to get back) in safe exploration.

title: Risk-Sensitive Reinforcement Learning Applied to Control under Constraints
summary: Defines risk as probability of entering error states and learns policies with risk below a threshold by adaptively weighting value and risk in a constrained MDP.
relation: Classic precedent for constraint-weighted (Lagrangian-like) safe RL; single agent, no budget dynamics.

title: Policy Invariance Under Reward Transformations: Theory and Application to Reward Shaping
summary: Proves potential-based reward shaping preserves optimal policies.
relation: Justifies potential-based shaping of the search reward (e.g., entropy reduction) without changing the optimal policy.

title: Constrained Markov Decision Processes
summary: Altman's monograph on constrained MDPs: occupation measures, LP and Lagrangian approaches.
relation: Foundational formalism for the thesis's constrained dose formulation.

title: Learning Infinite-Horizon Average-Reward CMDPs via State Augmentation
summary: Average-reward CMDP algorithm that augments the state with cumulative constraint violation, achieving sqrt(T) regret and violation.
relation: Theoretical support for putting accumulated cost (dose used) into the state.

title: Safe Exploration via Policy Priors
summary: SOOPER explores optimistically with probabilistic models but falls back to a conservative prior policy when needed, with safety guarantees throughout learning and regret bounds.
relation: Fallback-to-safe-policy mechanism parallels the thesis's withdraw action and safety layer.

title: Reachability-Aware Diffusion Policy Optimization
summary: RADPO combines a learned first-hit reachability value with cumulative-cost budget feedback via a dual-like multiplier to train safe diffusion policies.
relation: Combines predictive safety with budget feedback, akin to the thesis's mask plus Lagrangian; generic benchmarks.

title: Chance-Constrained Inspection Viewpoint Sequencing for On-Orbit Servicing via Safe Reinforcement Learning
summary: PPO-Lagrangian with PID-controlled multiplier sequences spacecraft inspection viewpoints under a chance constraint on keep-out violation and a delta-v budget.
relation: Chance-constrained Lagrangian RL with a non-renewable resource budget in an inspection task; single agent.

title: Continue, Abort, or Fall: Viability-Aware Policy Selection (VAPS) for Safe Humanoid Acrobatics
summary: VAPS learns predictors to choose at each step between continuing, aborting or a protective fall policy for humanoid acrobatics.
relation: Learned continue/abort decision parallels the thesis's withdraw action.

title: SteinGate: Tail-Sensitive Safe Reinforcement Learning via Stein Discrepancy
summary: SteinGate uses kernelized Stein discrepancy as a distributional safety certificate on rollout cost tails to switch between reward improvement and recovery.
relation: Tail-sensitive cost handling relates to the thesis's percentile-based safety; not multi-agent or budget-based.

title: Conformal Risk-Calibrated Latent World Models with Runtime Assurance Under Distribution Shift
summary: Converts ensemble disagreement into conformally calibrated uncertainty radii and a runtime governor that switches to a backup action when predicted envelopes near safety limits.
relation: Addresses model overconfidence under shift with calibrated fallback, relevant to the thesis's overconfident particle filter finding.

title: SCOPE: Safety-Constrained Online Preview Enforcement for Efficient Encirclement in Multi-UAV Pursuit-Evasion
summary: SCOPE: safe MARL with learned short-horizon safety preview and hierarchical online action correction for multi-UAV encirclement.
relation: Look-ahead action correction in MARL akin to a safety layer; collision rather than cumulative dose.

title: Learning to Harvest Without Collapse in a Regenerative Commons: A Lagrangian Framework
summary: Lagrangian framework for constrained multi-agent games with a designer-specified depletion budget on a shared regenerative resource, with feasibility certificates.
relation: Team-level budget constraint in MARL; resource is shared rather than per-agent non-renewable dose.

title: Utility-Constrained Policy Optimization
summary: Practical method for utility-constrained MDPs enabling risk-sensitive constraints without fixing limits in advance.
relation: Risk-sensitive alternative to expected-cost constraints used by MAPPO-Lagrangian.

title: Safety Internalization in UAV Navigation via Training-Time CBF-Integrated RL
summary: Shows post-hoc CBF shields can raise collision rates due to distribution shift and proposes training the policy toward the CBF-projected safe action (CBFT-PPO).
relation: Relevant to how the thesis's safety mask interacts with policy learning.

title: Safety-Constrained Reinforcement Learning with Post-Training Reachability Verification for Robot Navigation
summary: CVaR-constrained TD3 for robot navigation with post-training neural reachability verification under observation uncertainty.
relation: Tail-risk constraint precedent; not cumulative dose or multi-agent.

title: Stochastic Decision Horizons for Survival-Based Constrained Reinforcement Learning
summary: Stochastic decision horizons treat violations as shortening the effective horizon (survival) rather than spending a cumulative budget; off-policy algorithms.
relation: Contrasting formulation to the thesis's cumulative budget constraint.

title: Safe Deep Reinforcement Learning for Energy Management of Electrified Vehicles: Optimal Action Filtering and Battery-in-the-Loop Validation
summary: Safe SAC energy management combining a model-based action-filtering safety layer with Lagrangian penalisation; zero violations in training and deployment.
relation: Same combination (safety layer plus Lagrangian) in another domain.

title: Chance-Constrained DRL for Energy-Efficient and Timely Wind-Powered WSNs Under Uncertain Underground Mine Environments
venue: IEEE Transactions on Green Communications and Networking
summary: Distributionally robust chance-constrained MAPPO with an offline Lagrangian penalty for wind-powered WSNs in mines, converting chance constraints into deterministic margins via Bernstein bounds and CVaR.
relation: Methodological precedent for MAPPO with Lagrangian and tail-risk margins; unrelated application.

title: Structural Dual Adaptation for Safe Reinforcement Learning
summary: SDLA replaces bang-bang Lagrange multiplier response with a continuous one, reducing oscillations; tested with PPO/SAC on OmniSafe and HASARD.
relation: Relevant to stabilizing MAPPO-Lagrangian training.

title: Adaptive Safety Filtering for Frozen ACC Policies via Conformal Residual Calibration
summary: Calibrates residuals of a nominal predictor via conformal quantiles to set safety-filter margins online when deployment dynamics differ from training.
relation: Calibration remedy relevant to the thesis' overconfident filter under model error.

title: Optimistic Exploration for Risk-Averse Constrained Reinforcement Learning
summary: ORAC: risk-averse constrained actor-critic using upper bound on reward and lower bound on risk-averse cost value with adaptive cost weighting.
relation: Risk-averse constrained RL alternative to Lagrangian MAPPO.

title: Beyond Rewards: Extended Evaluation Metrics for Safe Reinforcement Learning with PPO-Lagrangian
venue: International Conference on Advancements in Computational Sciences
summary: Evaluates PPO-Lagrangian with CVaR, safety budget utilization ratio, violation and recovery rates in Safety-Gymnasium.
relation: Evaluation metrics (budget utilization, CVaR) applicable to dose budget results.

title: A safe multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm using constraint update projection approach
summary: Title only: safe multi-agent RL algorithm using a constraint update projection approach.
relation: Alternative safe MARL baseline to MAPPO-Lagrangian.

title: Adaptive Shielding for Safe Reinforcement Learning under Hidden-Parameter Dynamics Shifts
summary: Adaptive Shielding infers hidden dynamics parameters online with a function encoder and adapts a shield, plus safety-regularized optimization.
relation: Shield adapting to inferred hidden parameters parallels the thesis's mask driven by an online source estimate.

title: Action Masking Methods for Safe Reinforcement Learning in a Non-Stationary Configurable Environment
venue: International Conference on System Theory, Control and Computing
summary: Compares hard action masking with a soft annealed masking based on empirical risk in a partially observable environment.
relation: Action masking precedent for the thesis's safety layer.

title: A Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability Framework with Soft Constraints for Safety-Critical Systems
summary: Extends HJ reachability to soft constraints permitting temporary bounded violations, e.g. battery state of charge.
relation: Formal analog of budgeted exposure; no learning or multi-agent.

title: Constraint-Aware Reinforcement Learning via Adaptive Action Scaling
summary: Modular cost-aware regulator that smoothly scales actions based on predicted constraint violations instead of overriding them, achieving strong return-to-cost ratios on Safety Gym.
relation: Alternative to the thesis' hard masking safety layer based on predicted cost.

title: A Survey of Safe Reinforcement Learning and Constrained MDPs: A Technical Survey on Single-Agent and Multi-Agent Safety
summary: Technical survey of CMDP-based safe RL and safe MARL, with open problems in safe multi-agent settings.
relation: Background survey for MAPPO-Lagrangian framing.

title: Fault Tolerant Multi-Agent Learning with Adversarial Budget Constraints
summary: MARTA adds a switcher-adversary that induces agent malfunctions in critical states to make cooperative MARL robust to failures.
relation: Robustness to agent loss, analogous to robot dose failure; adversarial rather than budgeted.

title: Tackling Uncertainties in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning through Integration of Agent Termination Dynamics
summary: Integrates distributional learning with a barrier-function loss built from agent termination/fault dynamics to improve safe cooperative MARL.
relation: Handles agent termination in MARL, related to robots exhausting dose budgets.

title: Learning to Navigate Under Imperfect Perception: Conformalised Segmentation for Safe Reinforcement Learning
summary: COPPOL uses conformal segmentation to produce calibrated hazard maps with bounds on missed detections, inducing risk-aware cost fields for RL navigation.
relation: Calibrated hazard perception feeding RL, relevant to overconfidence of the source estimate.

title: A Review of Safe Reinforcement Learning: Methods, Theories, and Applications
summary: Review of safe RL methods, theories and applications (summary from title; abstract not retrieved).
relation: Survey for framing the thesis within safe RL.

title: Safe multi-agent reinforcement learning for bimanual dexterous manipulation
venue: IEEE/RJS International Conference on Intelligent RObots and Systems
summary: Multi-agent constrained proximal advantage optimization with sequential agent updates for individual and collective safety constraints.
relation: Safe MARL algorithm with per-agent and team constraints, comparable to MAPPO-Lagrangian.

title: Safe Reinforcement Learning in Black-Box Environments via Adaptive Shielding
summary: ADVICE post-shield learns safe/unsafe state-action features with a contrastive autoencoder to block likely hazardous actions.
relation: Learned shield alternative to the thesis's model-based percentile mask.

title: Safety Gymnasium: A Unified Safe Reinforcement Learning Benchmark
summary: Unified safe RL benchmark covering single- and multi-agent safety tasks (summary from title; abstract not retrieved).
relation: Benchmark context for evaluating safe MARL baselines.

title: OmniSafe: An Infrastructure for Accelerating Safe Reinforcement Learning Research
summary: Open-source framework implementing many safe RL algorithms (Lagrangian, CPO-family, PID-Lagrangian, etc.).
relation: Possible source of reference implementations for Lagrangian/PID baselines.

title: Safe Model-Based Multi-Agent Mean-Field Reinforcement Learning
summary: Safe-M3-UCRL uses epistemic transition uncertainty in a log-barrier to satisfy global distributional constraints pessimistically in mean-field MARL.
relation: Multi-agent pessimistic constraint satisfaction under model uncertainty.

title: Provably Learning Nash Policies in Constrained Markov Potential Games
summary: Constrained Markov potential games: shows Lagrangian primal-dual can fail (no strong duality) and gives a provable coordinate-ascent algorithm.
relation: Theoretical caution for Lagrangian safe MARL with per-agent constraints such as individual dose budgets.

title: Safe Offline Reinforcement Learning with Real-Time Budget Constraints
summary: TREBI handles dynamically specified safety budgets at deployment via trajectory-distribution diffusion planning in offline safe RL.
relation: Budget-conditioned policies relate to robots with unequal budgets; offline and single-agent.

title: DePAint: a decentralized safe multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm considering peak and average constraints
summary: DePAint: decentralized safe MARL algorithm handling both peak and average constraints with privacy.
relation: Hard (peak) plus average constraints relate to hard dose budget vs expected-cost Lagrangian.

title: Safe Learning in Robotics: From Learning-Based Control to Safe Reinforcement Learning
venue: Annual Review of Control, Robotics, and Autonomous Systems
summary: Reviews safe learning in robotics, unifying learning-based control, safe RL and certification methods.
relation: Robotics-oriented survey covering safety filters and constrained RL.

title: Safe Reinforcement Learning of Dynamic High-Dimensional Robotic Tasks: Navigation, Manipulation, Interaction
venue: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation
summary: Safe exploration in the tangent space of the constraint manifold so RL actions always satisfy constraints locally; deployed on TIAGo++.
relation: Alternative safety-layer design to action masking.

title: On the Robustness of Safe Reinforcement Learning under Observational Perturbations
summary: Shows optimal safe RL policies are vulnerable to observational perturbations and proposes robust training.
relation: Relevant to safety when observations/estimates are wrong, as with an overconfident filter.

title: DESTA: A Framework for Safe Reinforcement Learning with Markov Games of Intervention
summary: DESTA: a safety agent can take control from the task agent at selected states to minimise violations while the task agent maximises reward.
relation: Intervention-based safety related to safety layer/withdraw override; single agent.

title: First Order Constrained Optimization in Policy Space
summary: FOCOPS solves the constrained update in nonparametric policy space and projects back, with a bound on worst-case violation.
relation: Alternative first-order constrained baseline.

title: IPO: Interior-Point Policy Optimization under Constraints
summary: Adds logarithmic barrier functions on cumulative constraints to a PPO objective.
relation: Barrier-based alternative to Lagrangian multipliers for cumulative-cost constraints.

title: Exploration-Exploitation in Constrained MDPs
summary: Analyses optimistic LP-based and primal-dual algorithms for learning unknown CMDPs, with sublinear regret and constraint-violation regret; LP approach gives stronger guarantees.
relation: Shows primal-dual learning only bounds violations sublinearly, motivating a hard mask for a non-renewable budget.

title: Projection-Based Constrained Policy Optimization
summary: Projection-based constrained policy optimization with bounds on reward improvement and constraint violation.
relation: Alternative constrained RL algorithm to Lagrangian MAPPO.

title: Constrained Reinforcement Learning Has Zero Duality Gap
summary: Proves CMDPs have zero duality gap despite non-convexity, justifying primal-dual methods with rich parameterizations.
relation: Theoretical justification for Lagrangian approaches, which only hold in expectation, not per mission.

title: Control Barrier Functions: Theory and Applications
summary: Survey of control barrier functions for verifying and enforcing safety in optimization-based controllers.
relation: Background on forward-invariance-based safety filters.

title: Benchmarking Safe Exploration in Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Title only: benchmark suite for safe exploration in deep RL (Safety Gym).
relation: Standard constrained-RL benchmark and Lagrangian baselines the thesis' MAPPO-Lagrangian builds on.

title: Worst Cases Policy Gradients
summary: Worst Cases Policy Gradients optimizes policies for varying CVaR levels from a learned return distribution.
relation: Risk-sensitive alternative to percentile masking of dose.

title: Lyapunov-based Safe Policy Optimization for Continuous Control
summary: Lyapunov-based safe policy optimization projecting policy parameters or actions onto a feasible set, compatible with DDPG/PPO; tested on MuJoCo and indoor robot navigation.
relation: Action-projection safety layer precedent for the thesis's action masking, though with a known cost model.

title: Safe Model-based Reinforcement Learning with Stability Guarantees
summary: Uses GP models and Lyapunov stability to safely expand the region of attraction during learning.
relation: Background on safe learning with statistical models of uncertainty.

title: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms
summary: Proximal Policy Optimization: clipped surrogate objective enabling multiple minibatch epochs per batch.
relation: Base algorithm underlying MAPPO and MAPPO-Lagrangian used in the thesis.

title: Control Barrier Function Based Quadratic Programs for Safety Critical Systems
summary: Control barrier function based QPs unifying safety (forward invariance) and performance (CLF) in real-time controllers.
relation: Foundational safety-filter precedent for the thesis' action-masking safety layer.

title: Safe, Multi-Agent, Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Decomposes driving into a learned desires policy and non-learned trajectory planning with hard safety constraints.
relation: Early precedent for combining learned policies with a hard-constraint safety layer in multi-agent settings.

title: Optimizing the CVaR via Sampling
summary: Sampling-based likelihood-ratio estimator of the CVaR gradient with convergence to local CVaR optima.
relation: Background for tail-risk policy optimization of dose.

title: A comprehensive survey on safe reinforcement learning
summary: Classic survey separating safe RL into modifying the optimization criterion and modifying the exploration process.
relation: Seminal framing: Lagrangian (criterion) vs mask/shield (exploration) approaches.

title: Reachability-based safe learning with Gaussian processes
venue: IEEE Conference on Decision and Control
summary: Title only: reachability-based safe learning with Gaussian processes.
relation: Safety-set precedent under learned model uncertainty.

title: When Information is Worth the Risk: Behavioral Valuation for Hazardous Robotic Exploration
summary: Hazardous exploration where collecting information can cause robot failure that truncates future sensing; introduces a risk-augmented behavioral information objective (Prelec weighting) yielding conservative-to-aggressive information-risk trade-offs.
relation: Directly addresses 'is the information worth the risk' with failure-truncated missions while mapping unknown hazards (incl. radiation); risk is failure probability, not dose budget with exit reserve.

title: Cooperative Risk-Aware Exploration in Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Systems Using Algorithmic Altruism
summary: Game-theoretic exploration with Hamilton's-rule-inspired relatedness weights so lower-valued robots accept hazard exposure when it benefits higher-valued teammates, reallocating risk by agent value.
relation: Directly addresses 'who takes the risk' in heterogeneous teams; hazard exposure is a penalty rather than a hard cumulative budget with exit reserve.

title: Risk-averse traversal of graphs with stochastic and correlated edge costs for safe global planetary mobility
summary: Risk-averse Canadian Traveller Problem variant minimizing CVaR of traverse cost with exact AND-OR search; with correlated uncertain regions, information-seeking detours mitigate risk.
relation: Cost uncertainty is resolved by observation and detours are taken for information, coupling cost and information; single robot, no budget exhaustion/return.

title: A Hough transform approach to safety-aware scalar field mapping using Gaussian Processes
summary: Robot maps an unknown scalar field with a GP while avoiding regions whose field value exceeds a safety threshold; high-intensity regions are estimated online (Hough transform) and safe sampling uses probabilistic GP guarantees.
relation: The hazard IS the field being estimated (as with radiation intensity); safety is a pointwise threshold rather than a cumulative dose budget with exit reserve.

title: Dec-MARVEL: Decentralized Multi-Agent Exploration without Communication under Budget Constraints
summary: Dec-MARVEL: decentralized multi-UAV exploration policy conditioned on each robot's remaining travel budget, which must reserve enough to return to base; outperforms baselines across 2-8 robots and three budgets, with physical tests.
relation: Very close structural precedent: per-robot non-renewable budget with return reserve in a learned multi-robot policy; differs in that the budget is deterministic travel distance, not dose predicted from an uncertain source estimate.

title: Bi-objective trail-planning for a robot team orienteering in a hazardous environment
summary: Bi-objective ant colony optimization for robot-team trails on a graph with arc survival probabilities (e.g., radiation, adversaries), producing the Pareto front of expected team reward vs. expected number of surviving robots, incl. a nuclear-plant case.
relation: Explicit reward-vs-robot-survival trade-off and radiation hazards; hazards are known per arc and loss is probabilistic rather than a cumulative dose budget.

title: Risk-Bounded Multi-Agent Visual Navigation via Iterative Risk Allocation
venue: Proceedings of the  ... International Conference on Automated Planning and Scheduling
summary: Risk-bounded MAPF where agents share a global risk budget dynamically distributed into per-agent budgets via iterative (greedy or market) risk allocation.
relation: Direct precedent for risk sharing / reallocating budgets across agents; risk is static edge risk, not cumulative dose from an estimated source.

title: Behaviorally Adaptive Multi-Robot Hazard Localization in Failure-Prone, Communication-Denied Environments
summary: Behavior-Adaptive Path Planning (BAPP) uses behavioral entropy with a tunable risk-sensitivity parameter for multi-robot hazard mapping in failure-prone, communication-denied environments; BAPP-SIG improves robot survivability with little information loss.
relation: Close analogue: multi-robot hazard search trading information against robot failure risk, but risk is a per-step failure probability rather than a cumulative non-renewable dose budget with exit reserve.

title: Eclares: Energy-Aware Clarity-Driven Ergodic Search
summary: Clarity-based information map for ergodic search plus an energy-aware filter that iteratively validates the trajectory so the robot always retains enough energy to return to the charging station.
relation: The 'eware' filter is an explicit return-feasibility reserve check (close analogue of exit reserve) but with renewable energy and a known consumption model.

title: Distributed Multi-robot Online Sampling with Budget Constraints
summary: Online distributed MCTS-based multi-robot sampling where each robot selects its next sampling location considering its remaining travel budget, to reconstruct an unknown scalar field.
relation: Per-robot non-renewable travel budget in a team estimating an unknown field; budget spent is distance, not the field value itself.

title: Valuing Attrition in a Fleet of Robots Used as Path-Based Sensors for Gathering Information in a Communications Restricted Environment
summary: Finite robot fleet searching a hazardous, communications-denied area; robot survival along paths is itself used as a sensor to update hazard and target belief maps, and planning accounts for lost future information when an agent is lost.
relation: Very close: hazard map is unknown and estimated online, and losing robots costs future information; resource is binary survival rather than cumulative dose with a return reserve.

title: Planning under uncertainty for safe robot exploration using Gaussian process prediction
summary: Safe exploration where safety means staying in regions with environmental values (e.g., radiation) below a threshold, predicted by a GP and embedded in an MDP balancing information, safety and distance; physical robot test underground.
relation: Safety depends on an uncertain estimate of the field, as in the thesis, but per-step threshold rather than cumulative dose budget and single robot.

title: Hierarchical Motion Planning Under Probabilistic Temporal Tasks and Safe-Return Constraints
summary: MDP planning under LTL tasks with safe-return constraints requiring a return policy to safe states with high probability; synthesizes outbound and return policies jointly.
relation: Formalizes 'always keep a way back' probabilistically, akin to exit reserve, but with no cumulative budget and a known model.

title: Reconstructing a Spatial Field with an Autonomous Robot Under a Budget Constraint
summary: GP-based informative sampling for a single robot in a stochastic environment that must reach a preassigned final site before the travel budget is exhausted, using a generative model to predict consumed energy and decide when to end the mission.
relation: Very close: budget must cover the trip to a final site and the consumed energy is stochastic/predicted; however the cost uncertainty is not tied to the field being estimated.

title: Adaptive and Risk-Aware Target Tracking for Robot Teams With Heterogeneous Sensors
summary: Robot team with heterogeneous sensors tracks targets/hazards whose proximity induces sensor failures, balancing tracking quality against sensor preservation and adapting to failures that occurred.
relation: Very close in spirit: proximity-dependent damage traded against estimation quality in a team; no cumulative budget or exit requirement.

title: Optimization-Based Robot Team Exploration Considering Attrition and Communication Constraints
summary: Team exploration planning that optimizes expected utility accounting for the possibility that robots fail due to environmental hazards, under communication constraints.
relation: Explicitly plans for robot loss in a team; failure probabilities are modeled rather than a dose budget that must cover exit.

title: Heterogeneous Vehicle Routing and Teaming with Gaussian Distributed Energy Uncertainty
summary: Stochastic programming for heterogeneous vehicle routing where travel energy costs are estimated by GP regression and handled as chance constraints or recourse costs.
relation: Energy cost is uncertain and learned (GP), with chance-constrained budgets for heterogeneous vehicles; the cost field is not the mission's estimation target.

title: A unified framework for operational range estimation of mobile robots operating on a single discharge to avoid complete immobilization
summary: Unified energy-consumption models across robot platforms to estimate operational range online/offline, so a robot on a single discharge can explore while guaranteeing a safe return home.
relation: Single non-renewable discharge with guaranteed return is very close to the dose budget + exit reserve; consumption is estimated online but does not depend on the explored field.

title: Multi-UAV resource constrained online monitoring of large-scale spatio-temporal environment with homing guarantee
summary: Bi-objective budget-limited informative path planning for multi-UAV spatio-temporal monitoring with constraints guaranteeing every robot returns to the base station within its operational range.
relation: Budgeted multi-robot IPP with an explicit homing constraint (exit reserve); travel cost is known distance, not an uncertain estimate.

title: The Team Surviving Orienteers problem: routing teams of robots in uncertain environments with survival constraints
summary: Routing K robots on a graph whose edges carry survival probabilities to maximize expected visited reward while each robot satisfies a minimum probability of surviving the mission (returning).
relation: Core analogue of team risk allocation under robot loss with a per-robot survival constraint; risk per edge is known a priori rather than an estimate updated by sensing.

title: The Matroid Team Surviving Orienteers problem: Constrained routing of heterogeneous teams with risky traversal
summary: Extends the TSO to heterogeneous teams under matroid constraints, where each robot may fail when traversing an edge, with approximation guarantees for expected reward.
relation: Addresses heterogeneous robots sharing risk (who goes where); survival probabilities are known, not estimated, and resource is not a cumulative budget.

title: The risk-sensitive coverage problem: Multi-robot routing under uncertainty with service level and survival constraints
venue: IEEE Conference on Decision and Control
summary: Title only: multi-robot routing under uncertainty with service level and survival constraints.
relation: Precedent for multi-robot missions with robot survival probability constraints in hazardous environments.

title: A Multi-robot Control Policy for Information Gathering in the Presence of Unknown Hazards
summary: Robots gather information in an environment with unknown hazards (e.g., radiation, fire) that can disable them; Bayesian filters estimate events and hazards online and robots follow the mutual-information gradient, which naturally trades informativeness vs. failure.
relation: Cost/risk and information are coupled: the hazard field is unknown and estimated from the same team's observations; failure is probabilistic rather than a cumulative non-renewable budget.

title: Collaborative Exploration by Energy-Constrained Mobile Robots
summary: Theoretical study of exploring an unknown tree with agents whose energy bounds the number of edges traversed, so a team is needed and agents must return to the root.
relation: Non-renewable per-agent budget that must include the return trip, as in the thesis; but cost is unit edge length, not an uncertain field-dependent dose.

title: Energy-Constrained Resilient Multirobot Coverage Control
venue: IEEE Transactions on Control Systems Technology
summary: Hybrid coverage/return-to-base/recharge MPC framework with energy guard conditions, plus network reconfiguration so the team stays connected while robots leave to recharge.
relation: Similar to 'withdraw while team continues' (team reconfigures when members leave), but robots return after recharge and energy cost is deterministic.

title: Energy-Oriented Multi-Robot Collaborative Exploration and Mapping for Nuclear Power Plant Operation and Maintenance Based on I-WFD-Gmapping-DT
summary: Multi-robot frontier exploration and mapping for NPP maintenance with a utility combining information gain, path cost, battery energy and safety constraints, plus energy- and risk-aware task allocation.
relation: Multi-robot exploration in radiation-risk plants with a per-robot resource (battery) in the utility, but no dose budget, exit reserve or source estimation.

title: A Capability-Aware Backup-Recoverability Filter for Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Navigation
summary: Capability-aware backup-recoverability filter keeps each heterogeneous robot's action within a set that preserves a certified recovery maneuver, with recursive feasibility.
relation: Preserving access to a recovery manoeuvre parallels the thesis's exit-reserve mask; applied to collision safety, not dose.

title: The hazardous team orienteering problem
summary: Hazardous Team Orienteering Problem: fleet routing where visiting hazardous nodes incurs time-dependent risk of catastrophic loss of the route's profit; exact branch-and-price and ALNS.
relation: Combinatorial analogue of exposure-limited team missions where lingering in hazards risks losing everything collected; no estimation uncertainty.

title: Bayesian Networks for Path-Based Sensors: Gathering Information and Path Planning in Communication Denied Environments
summary: Bayesian-network belief update where a robot failing to return from a path signals a hazard; plans information-gaining paths for single and multi-robot teams.
relation: Treats robot attrition in hazardous fields as information; thesis instead prevents loss via dose budgets and withdrawal.

title: URGE: Urgency-Aware Energy-Efficient UAV Mobility via Hybrid Deep Reinforcement Learning
venue: ACM Symposium on Solid Modeling and Applications
summary: URGE combines DRL with a deterministic safety shield that enforces return-to-charger under hard battery constraints for disaster-response UAVs, achieving 100% fleet survivability.
relation: Close precedent for exit reserve shield with a hard resource budget; budget is battery, not dose predicted from an uncertain source estimate.

title: Energy-constrained multi-robot exploration for autonomous map building
summary: Multi-robot frontier exploration of an unknown map where robots must discover and repeatedly visit charging stations; combines frontier exploration, graph planning and task assignment with recursive-feasibility conditions.
relation: Energy is renewable (recharging) and travel cost is deterministic given the map; no non-renewable budget or uncertain field-dependent cost.

title: Autonomous Air-Ground Vehicle Operations Optimization in Hazardous Environments: A Multi-Armed Bandit Approach
summary: Dispatch framework for UAV sensing and UGV cleaning in hazardous (chemical/radiological) sites using Bayesian UCB and routing with profits under resource constraints.
relation: Heterogeneous team under uncertain hazard levels and resource limits; no per-robot exposure accumulation.

title: Reinforcement Learning-Based Energy-Aware Coverage Path Planning for Precision Agriculture
venue: Research in Adaptive and Convergent Systems
summary: SAC-based energy-aware coverage path planning with CNN/LSTM, rewarding coverage while respecting energy and return-to-base constraints.
relation: RL precedent for a resource reserve to return; energy is deterministic, not estimate-dependent dose.

title: Task Allocation and Online Planning for Multi-Agent Systems with Safe-Return Constraints under Temporal Logic Specifications
venue: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Unmanned Systems (ICUS)
summary: Task allocation and online planning for multi-agent systems with local safe-return tasks under LTL specifications using MILP.
relation: Explicit safe-return precedent for teams, like the exit reserve; constraint is logical, not dose-based.

title: Energy-Aware Ergodic Search: Continuous Exploration for Multi-Agent Systems with Battery Constraints
summary: Ergodic search trajectories for multi-agent systems that incorporate battery dynamics so agents continuously explore while respecting energy limits and returning to recharge.
relation: Combines search with energy constraints, but energy is renewable and its consumption does not depend on the unknown field being searched.

title: Energy-Aware Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning Based on the Predictive Energy Consumption Algorithm for Search and Rescue Aerial Robots in Unknown Environments
summary: Hierarchical RL with an LSTM battery-consumption predictor so the high-level controller sets energy-feasible goals for SAR drones in unknown environments.
relation: Learned energy prediction gates goals (similar to masking by remaining budget); single agent, renewable battery.

title: Solving Stochastic Orienteering Problems With Chance Constraints Using Monte Carlo Tree Search
venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering
summary: MCTS for stochastic orienteering that estimates per-action probability of exceeding the travel budget and prunes violating actions.
relation: Close analog of budget-violation-probability action pruning; budget uncertainty from stochastic costs, not a searched field.

title: meSch: Multi-Agent Energy-Aware Scheduling for Task Persistence
venue: IEEE/RJS International Conference on Intelligent RObots and Systems
summary: meSch scheduling ensures a robot team with limited, heterogeneous battery discharge returns to a single charging station one at a time.
relation: Return-to-base under heterogeneous resource depletion in teams; renewable energy versus non-renewable dose.

title: Exploration–Exploitation Tradeoff in the Adaptive Information Sampling of Unknown Spatial Fields with Mobile Robots
summary: Analyzes exploration-exploitation weights in GP-based adaptive sampling of fields such as radiation, trading mapping/localization accuracy against energy in single and multi-robot settings, including heterogeneous energy.
relation: Resource-constrained (unequal energy) multi-robot field sampling; energy not dose and no exit reserve.

title: Risk-aware Recharging Rendezvous for a Collaborative Team of UAVs and UGVs
venue: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation
summary: Risk-aware recharging for UAV-UGV teams ensuring probability that no UAV runs out of charge exceeds a tolerance.
relation: Chance-constrained resource feasibility for return; energy is renewable at UGVs unlike dose.

title: The matroid team surviving orienteers problem and its variants: Constrained routing of heterogeneous teams with risky traversal
summary: Matroid Team Surviving Orienteers: route a heterogeneous robot team through a risky graph with per-robot survival probability constraints and team constraints; submodular approximation algorithms.
relation: Per-robot risk constraint in team planning resembles per-robot dose budgets; risk is known and probabilistic, not a cumulative dose from an uncertain source estimate.

title: Multi-Robot Heterogeneous Adversarial Coverage
venue: International Symposium on Multi-Robot and Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-robot coverage of areas with threats that may stop robots probabilistically, formulated as a Dec-POMDP and solved with MARL accounting for heterogeneous robots.
relation: Risk sharing among heterogeneous robots under hazards; risk is probabilistic loss, not cumulative dose.

title: Energy Autonomy for Robot Systems With Constrained Resources
summary: Control-barrier-function framework guaranteeing energy sufficiency for battery-powered multi-robot systems that must share limited charging stations while performing missions.
relation: Formal guarantee that robots never run out of energy before reaching a charger (a reserve constraint), but energy is renewable and consumption models are known.

title: The hazardous orienteering problem
summary: Orienteering variant where picked-up parcels may trigger a catastrophic event with probability growing with time on board, wiping out all collected profit; MINLP formulation and bounds.
relation: Risk accumulates with exposure time (dose-like) and total loss on failure; single vehicle, known risk model, no sensing.

title: Online Planning of Uncertain MDPs under Temporal Tasks and Safe-Return Constraints
summary: Online planning where the robot explores and updates an uncertain MDP model in a Bayesian way while enforcing that it can always return home with high probability.
relation: Model learned online with a safe-return requirement; uncertainty in transitions is coupled to exploration, but no cumulative non-renewable budget.

title: Energy-Aware, Collision-Free Information Gathering for Heterogeneous Robot Teams
summary: Hierarchical planner trading information gain against energy cost for heterogeneous robot teams with CBF-based collision safety.
relation: Resource-aware multi-robot informative sensing; energy is a cost term, not a hard non-renewable budget with exit.

title: MARLAS: Multi Agent Reinforcement Learning for cooperated Adaptive Sampling
venue: International Symposium on Distributed Autonomous Robotic Systems
summary: MARLAS learns decentralized multi-robot sampling policies for environmental fields within a fixed endurance budget.
relation: Budgeted multi-robot information gathering with MARL; budget is endurance, not hazard exposure.

title: Multi-Robot Information Gathering Subject to Resource Constraints
summary: Multi-robot information gathering using a GMM prior of informative regions, computing paths that optimize travel cost subject to energy budgets and replanning online as the model updates.
relation: Energy budgets per robot with online model updates; energy cost is travel-based and known.

title: Multi-Robot Path Planning for Mobile Sensing through Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Deep RL for multi-robot informative path planning where battery-powered robots have limited travel distances, learning informative paths for parallel data collection.
relation: Learning-based budgeted multi-robot IPP; budget is travel distance, not an uncertain field-dependent cost.

title: Risk-aware Collection Strategies for Multirobot Foraging in Hazardous Environments
venue: ACM Transactions on Autonomous and Adaptive Systems
summary: Multirobot foraging where robots collecting items in hazardous environments face risks to themselves; proposes risk-aware collection strategies.
relation: Team-level risk management in hazardous collection; does not model a cumulative budget that must cover the return trip.

title: Multi-robot task allocation for safe planning against stochastic hazard dynamics
summary: Two-stage multi-robot safe mission planning: stochastic reachability per robot plus greedy/auction task allocation.
relation: Multi-robot hazard-aware allocation; safety probability not cumulative dose.

title: Multi-robot Coordination and Planning in Uncertain and Adversarial Environments
summary: Review of multi-robot coordination under uncertainty and adversaries: resilient coordination, risk-aware coordination and GNN-based methods.
relation: Survey framing for risk-aware multi-robot teams.

title: Learning a Spatial Field in Minimum Time With a Team of Robots
summary: Constant-factor approximations for learning a GP field to a posterior-variance threshold, including a multirobot version minimizing time for the last robot to return to the depot.
relation: Includes required return to a common depot; objective is time with known travel costs rather than a budget whose consumption depends on the field.

title: Risk-Aware Planning and Assignment for Ground Vehicles using Uncertain Perception from Aerial Vehicles
summary: Bayesian deep segmentation of aerial imagery yields uncertain traversal costs; CVaR is used for risk-aware multi-robot path planning and assignment.
relation: Uncertain, perception-derived costs feed risk-aware team assignment; costs are not consumed from a non-renewable budget and no return is modeled.

title: Robust Multiple-Path Orienteering Problem: Securing Against Adversarial Attacks
summary: Robust multiple-path orienteering for robot teams with path-length budgets and worst-case guarantees against attacks disabling up to alpha robots.
relation: Team routing under budgets and robot loss; static planning, not exposure-driven.

title: CARE: Cooperative Autonomy for Resilience and Efficiency of robot teams for complete coverage of unknown environments under robot failures
summary: Multi-robot coverage of unknown environments that reallocates work when robots fail unexpectedly, preserving complete coverage.
relation: Analogous to the team continuing after a robot withdraws; failures are exogenous rather than chosen withdrawals driven by a budget.

title: Off-road ground robot path energy cost prediction through probabilistic spatial mapping
summary: GP regression maps terrain/position features to power consumption to predict future path energy costs with correlated uncertainty, avoiding overconfidence.
relation: Cost along a path is an uncertain spatial estimate built from the robot's own measurements, analogous to dose-rate map uncertainty; no team or return-reserve planning.

title: RADMPC: A Fast Decentralized Approach for Chance-Constrained Multi-Vehicle Path-Planning
summary: Decentralized chance-constrained multi-vehicle path planning with iterative risk allocation.
relation: Risk allocation across vehicles is a precedent for distributing risk/budget among team members.

title: Coordinated recharging of mobile robots during exploration
summary: Compares five policies for robot teams sharing limited charging points while exploring an unknown structured environment, with energy-aware decisions on when to return.
relation: Return to base is required but energy is renewable and consumption is known; analogous to an exit-reserve rule without uncertainty in cost.

title: Energy-Constrained Coordination of Multi-Robot Teams
venue: IEEE Transactions on Control Systems Technology
summary: Energy-aware rendezvous: robots with different initial battery levels decide where and when to meet so that all retain nonnegative battery at the meeting, solved distributedly.
relation: Directly handles unequal per-robot budgets with a hard 'arrive before depletion' constraint, but costs are deterministic and there is no sensing/estimation.

title: Exact and Heuristic Algorithms for Risk-Aware Stochastic Physical Search
summary: Agent searches physical locations for an item where travel and stochastic acquisition costs come from one shared budget and costs are revealed on arrival; MILP and branch-and-bound to maximize success probability.
relation: Single non-renewable budget shared by moving and searching with costs revealed only on arrival; no return requirement or team.

title: Sampling-based robotic information gathering algorithms
venue: The International Journal of Robotics Research
summary: RIG algorithms combine sampling-based motion planning with branch-and-bound to find informative trajectories within a fuel/energy/time budget, with asymptotic optimality.
relation: Seminal budgeted information gathering in continuous space; budget is deterministic and no return reserve or uncertain cost.

title: Efficient Informative Sensing using Multiple Robots
summary: Seminal eSIP approximation algorithm for budget-constrained informative paths maximizing GP mutual information, with sequential allocation extending guarantees to multi-robot teams.
relation: Foundational budgeted multi-robot IPP; budget is a known path-length/energy limit and robots are not at risk.

title: SAFARI: Semantic- And Frontier-driven Autonomous Risk Inspection
summary: SAFARI couples semantic detection with a probabilistic map for risk-aware exploration of hazardous objects on a quadruped in 11 field missions.
relation: Risk-aware hazard search, but risk is proximity-based and not a cumulative budget.

title: Risk-Averse Autonomous Material Handling in Healthcare Systems
venue: 2025 IEEE 21st International Conference on Automation Science and Engineering (CASE)
summary: Risk-averse grid path planning for hazardous material transport in hospitals integrating risk into transition costs with a risk budget.
relation: Risk-budget path planning precedent; unrelated hazard model.

title: Multirobot Persistent Monitoring: Minimizing Latency and Number of Robots With Recharging Constraints
summary: Multirobot persistent monitoring where robots with discharge time D must visit recharging depots; approximation algorithms minimize latency and team size.
relation: Battery is renewable and travel costs are known; addresses how many robots are needed under endurance limits rather than risk allocation.

title: Multi-Robot Informative Path Planning from Regression with Sparse Gaussian Processes
summary: Sparse-GP gradient-based multi-robot IPP in continuous environments that jointly optimizes informative paths under distance budgets and kinematic limits.
relation: Multi-robot IPP with distance budgets; cost is deterministic path length.

title: Distributed Multi-robot Information Gathering Using Path-Based Sensors in Entropy-Weighted Voronoi Regions
venue: International Symposium on Distributed Autonomous Robotic Systems
summary: Title only: distributed multi-robot information gathering with path-based sensors in entropy-weighted Voronoi regions.
relation: Precursor of path-based (robot loss) hazard sensing; no exposure budget.

title: Learning Risk-Aware Costmaps for Traversability in Challenging Environments
summary: Neural network learns the CVaR (tail risk) of traversability costs from data to build risk-aware costmaps, motivated by preserving robot life in caves and subways.
relation: CVaR over uncertain per-cell cost, a template for risk-aware dose costmaps; no budget accounting or team.

title: Risk-Aware Submodular Optimization for Multirobot Coordination
summary: Sequential greedy algorithm with approximation guarantees for CVaR-based submodular maximization, applied to vehicle assignment and sensor selection with failures.
relation: Risk-aware multi-robot coordination formalism; not sequential RL nor dose budgets.

title: Randomized algorithm for informative path planning with budget constraints
summary: Randomized Anytime Orienteering (RAOr) for budgeted IPP / correlated orienteering, posing it as CSP plus TSP for fast near-optimal online solutions.
relation: Budgeted orienteering with known edge costs; single robot, no risk.

title: Path-Based Sensors: Paths as Sensors, Bayesian Updates, and Shannon Information Gathering
venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering
summary: Treats whether a robot survives a path as a 'path-based sensor', derives the Bayesian update and expected Shannon information, and plans paths that learn about invisible robot-destroying hazards while also searching for victims.
relation: Formalizes the idea that the searcher's own damage/destruction is itself a measurement of the hazard, and that losing a robot destroys future information.

title: Risk-Aware Motion Planning in Partially Known Environments
venue: IEEE Conference on Decision and Control
summary: Builds a GP model of an unknown hazardous field (gas, radiation) from noisy samples and uses CVaR-based risk in sampling-based motion planning with online replanning.
relation: Safety cost computed from an uncertain estimate of the hazard field, like the thesis's percentile mask over particles; single robot, no cumulative budget or exit.

title: Learning about physical parameters: the importance of model discrepancy
summary: Shows that calibration ignoring model discrepancy yields biased and over-confident parameter estimates; a GP discrepancy fixes predictions but true parameters are recovered only with realistic priors.
relation: Theoretical explanation for the thesis's overconfident particle filter under spatially correlated model error.

title: A decentralized control policy for adaptive information gathering in hazardous environments
venue: IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC)
summary: Decentralized MI-gradient controller for resource-constrained robots that localize an unknown number of targets while avoiding hazards at unknown positions that cause robot failure, using finite-set statistics and adaptive cell decomposition.
relation: Earlier decentralized version of the hazard-aware information-gathering framework; direct precedent for a team trading information against robot loss.

title: Probabilistic Multi-Robot Gas Source Localization with Uncalibrated Sensors: A Distributed Estimation Approach
summary: Distributed probabilistic framework where each robot estimates a local belief so that heterogeneous, uncalibrated sensors with inconsistent responses can still be fused for source localization.
relation: Addresses inconsistent measurement models in shared beliefs, related to model-error-driven overconfidence.

title: SniffySquad: Patchiness-Aware Gas Source Localization with Multi-Robot Collaboration
summary: Multi-robot olfaction system that accounts for patchy real-world gas distributions, which break reactive and simplified-plume-model methods that work in idealized simulations.
relation: Evidence that simplified dispersion models fail in real spatially structured fields, motivating discrepancy-aware estimation.

title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for UAV-Based Chemical Plume Source Localization
summary: MARL framework with virtual anchor nodes for multi-UAV chemical plume source localization, outperforming fluxotaxis.
relation: Multi-agent RL source search in an analogous hazard domain; no agent exposure budget.

title: Information-Guided Safe Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Gas Source Localization using sUAS
summary: Information-guided safe RL for sUAS gas source localization; identifies a bias where planners exploit flawed early estimates, uses a KL-based meta-supervisor on estimator reliability and an RCBF for zero violations.
relation: Relevant to the thesis's overconfident-filter finding: monitors estimator reliability and couples estimation with safety in source search.

title: Hierarchical Role-Based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for UHF Radiation Source Localization with Heterogeneous UAV Swarms
summary: Hierarchical heterogeneous MARL (HMUDRL) with cluster-head and monitoring UAVs to localize UHF radio sources under payload and endurance limits, 96% success.
relation: Analogous multi-agent RL source search (RF instead of gamma); no hazard to agents.

title: UAV Mission Planning for Post-Disaster Victim Localisation via Federated Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Federated QMIX for multi-UAV victim localization with PSO position estimation, return-to-base and map-feasibility safety checks, and training state built on estimated victim locations.
relation: Analogous multi-agent search with return-to-base safety checks and estimate-based state; no cumulative hazard exposure.

title: Bayesian Decentralized Decision-Making for Multi-Robot Systems: Sample-Efficient Estimation of Event Rates
venue: IEEE International Symposium on Multi-Robot and Multi-Agent Systems (MRS)
summary: A swarm decides which of two areas is safer, each with an unknown Poisson rate of hazardous events, using conjugate Bayesian estimates and confidence to reduce exposure while sampling.
relation: Explicitly treats measurement as costly exposure and seeks sample-efficient collective decisions, akin to declaring a source with limited dose.

title: Multi-source plume tracing via multi-agent reinforcement learning under common UAV-faults
summary: MARL (LSTM-based action-specific double deep recurrent Q-network) for a sUAS swarm localizing multiple airborne pollution sources in a Gaussian-plume POMG with sensor noise; journal version considers common UAV faults.
relation: Closest MARL plume-source paper; agents can fault but no hazard-dose budget.

title: Enhanced Reward Function Design for Source Term Estimation Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Particle filter for gas source term estimation combined with DQN search policy; compares and proposes GMM-variance and information-gain rewards.
relation: Same PF+deep RL architecture in the gas domain; informs reward design; no agent exposure constraint.

title: RoLocMe: A Robust Multi-agent Source Localization System with Learning-based Map Estimation
venue: International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence
summary: RoLocMe: MARL system for (RF) source localization combining a learned RSS map estimator with cooperative dueling DQN and value decomposition; higher success than prior methods.
relation: Multi-agent RL source search analog without any agent exposure constraint.

title: Improved Socialtaxis for information-theoretic source search using cooperative multiple agents in turbulent environments
summary: Improves Socialtaxis with a continuous Rao-Blackwellized particle filter, a utility using distance to the estimated source to balance exploration/exploitation, sequential greedy decisions and connectivity preservation.
relation: Multi-agent information-theoretic source search with an explicit approach-the-source term; baseline for MARL comparisons.

title: Searching for a source without gradients: how good is infotaxis and how to beat it
venue: Proceedings of the Royal Society A
summary: Characterizes infotaxis performance from 1D to 4D in a POMDP framing and beats it with tree search, value-function heuristics and deep RL, which finds near-optimal policies.
relation: Supports using RL over hand-crafted information heuristics for source search.

title: Risk-Aware Path Planning for Unmanned Aerial Systems in a Spreading Wildfire
venue: Journal of Guidance, Control, and Dynamics
summary: Evidential fusion estimates wildfire state and flight-level heat aura under an inaccurate fire model; the UAV visits high-conflict locations and plans chance-constrained paths around a probabilistic keep-out zone.
relation: Hazard that damages the vehicle, uncertain hazard model, and information-seeking visits combined with risk constraints.

title: Source Term Estimation Using Deep Reinforcement Learning With Gaussian Mixture Model Feature Extraction for Mobile Sensors
summary: DRL (DDPG with GRU) for gas source term estimation where a particle filter's belief is compressed via a Gaussian mixture model as policy input; beats information-theoretic baselines.
relation: Direct precedent for feeding a particle filter belief to an RL search policy; single agent, gas, no exposure budget.

title: PDE solution to UAV/UGV trajectory planning problem by spatio-temporal estimation during wildfires
